git add internal/doctor/doctor.go internal/doctor/doctor_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(doctor): #3 — non-executable hooks are never executed by the sandbox

checkHookPresence ran hookInvocationObserved for every shell-shaped
enabled hook before its executable-bit check, and the sandbox copies
body at mode 0o755 regardless of the installed file's own permission
bits. A hook lacking +x — one git would never run at all — was still
having its untrusted shell content executed inside the sandbox solely
to diagnose that same non-executable state (qodo, PR #515).

Moved the executable-bit check immediately after Stat, before any
execution is attempted. Same FAIL message and remedy as before; the
only change is that a non-executable hook is now diagnosed without
ever running.

Regression test uses a witness file to prove the hook body does not
run; confirmed failing (witness present) against pre-fix code.
EOF
)"
